name: Dung grain
description: One handful of what is trodden into a rolling ball of dung: a dark clump, a lighter lump beside it, a sliver of chaff and a few specks of grit, drawn around a 6px patch. It is not an object in the game — it is the thing a big ball is short of. `ss.proj.dung` carries a fixed twenty-odd marks, which is a face at r=14 and a flat disc at r=140, so the weapon stamps this patch across the ball as it packs on: more of them the bigger it gets, at a size that grows only slowly, so a boulder reads as a boulder made of muck rather than as an enlargement of a small one. The game travels them across the face with the same surface the document's own `roll` clip moves, and skips any that would poke past the rim, so they roll rather than sit. Authored off-centre and asymmetric on purpose: a patch with a middle stamps as a pattern.

evolved.description: The same handful out of the evolved ball: shell chips and bone through it instead of chaff, and the rot gone hot.
